talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $10M sold across 7 Form D filings this week, down 92% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was NP Indiana Investors LLC (Bloomfield Hills, Other) targeting $7M. Good question to ask: are founders in other favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

1 Michigan-based pooled fund filed Form Ds, reporting $0 raised so far — led by New Community Transformation Fund II, L.P. (Venture Capital Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?

Mill Road Capital III, L.P. and others reported a 13.3% stake in Alta Equipment Group Inc. (ALTG) (Schedule 13D/A amendment 10). Schedule 13D filers can push for strategic change, so it's worth asking whether shareholders see a sale or restructuring on the table.
